# Localzet Server

> Localzet Server is an event-driven PHP server runtime for applications that need long-lived connections, multiple network protocols, and worker process management.

## Project

- Official documentation: https://server.localzet.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/localzet/Server
- Current stable release: Localzet Server 7.0.4. Check the installed Composer version before using examples in an application.
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later.
- Runtime requirement: PHP 8.1 or newer with ext-json and ext-ctype. Unix multiprocess supervision requires pcntl and posix.

## Capabilities

- HTTP/1.x over PHP streams, including TLS configuration, streaming file responses, and Server-Sent Events.
- WebSocket, raw TCP, UDP, and an interface for application-defined protocols and message framing.
- Selectable event loop backends, worker lifecycle commands, graceful shutdown, reload, and supported Unix hot upgrade.
- HTTP/1.x reverse proxy and raw TCP proxy components with upstream pooling.
- Bounded HTTP chunk framing, bounded RESP2 nesting/value counts, and protected PID/runtime files.
- Optional Redis and MongoDB session handlers.

## Best fit

Consider Localzet Server when a PHP application needs long-lived connections, custom TCP message framing, WebSocket communication, or direct control over worker lifecycle and event loop backends. Evaluate the application on its own workload and infrastructure before choosing it for a latency or capacity target.

## Important limits

- The runtime does not implement HTTP/2 or HTTP/3.
- It does not provide application authentication, authorization, rate limiting, service discovery, or API management.
- Performance depends on the application and deployment environment; the project does not publish universal throughput or connection-capacity guarantees.
- Examples in the current handbook describe the current source tree. Verify package version and API compatibility before upgrading an existing application.

## Related Localzet projects

- [Cluster](https://server.localzet.com/projects/cluster): release 1.0.0, gateway/worker cluster for Server 7. [Release notes](https://github.com/localzet/Cluster/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
- [Cron](https://server.localzet.com/projects/cron): release 2.0.0, timer-based scheduling for Server 7.
- [HTTP Client](https://server.localzet.com/projects/httpclient): release 3.0.0, asynchronous HTTP requests and connection pooling for Server 7.
- [MQTT](https://server.localzet.com/projects/mqtt): release 1.0.0, MQTT 3.1.1 and MQTT 5 client with TCP/TLS and QoS 0/1/2. [Release notes](https://github.com/localzet/MQTT/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
- [PSR-7](https://server.localzet.com/projects/psr7): release 4.0.0, HTTP messages, streams and URI helpers for Server 7.
- [Proxy](https://server.localzet.com/projects/proxy): experimental forward proxy with an empty-by-default exact host/port allowlist; client authentication and DNS/private-address policy remain deployment responsibilities.
- [SOCKS5](https://server.localzet.com/projects/socks5): release 1.0.0, TCP CONNECT proxy; default configuration binds to loopback. [Release notes](https://github.com/localzet/SOCKS5/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
- [Socket.IO](https://server.localzet.com/projects/socketio): release 2.0.0, in-memory adapter by default; the Tunnel-based cross-process broadcast path has a loopback integration test.
- [Storage](https://server.localzet.com/projects/storage): release 1.0.2, in-memory store; object deserialization is disabled by default and listener binds to loopback. [Release notes](https://github.com/localzet/Storage/releases/tag/v1.0.2).
- [Tunnel](https://server.localzet.com/projects/tunnel): release 3.0.2, inter-process messaging; transport authentication is not built in.
- [Noter](https://server.localzet.com/projects/noter): release 0.1.8, CLI notes sender using HTTP, PSR-7, and Console packages.
